name: Desenrolar pergaminho
description: O pergaminho antigo se abre e revela seu conteúdo.
context: Abertura da modal após selecionar um pergaminho disponível ou concluído na estante.
prompt: An ancient thick parchment scroll smoothly unrolling from its tightly rolled cylindrical form. Authentic dry parchment rustling, gentle layered friction and subtle movement of wooden rollers. One continuous opening motion with a natural soft ending. Close-up realistic Foley, elegant and restrained. No tearing, no crumpling, no music, no voices, no background noise.
observations: Sincronizar com a animação parchment-unroll de 0,95 s.
